request.style: English, contemporary worship anthem, bright male worship leader with congregation choir, electric guitars with delay, piano, synth pads, bass, building drums, triumphant and joyful, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The women came at sunrise with their spices and their tears
An angel met them at the tomb and spoke against their fears
He is not here; he has risen, just as he said
Come and see the place where he lay

[Chorus]
Death has been swallowed up in victory
Where, O death, is your victory?
Where, O death, is your sting?
Thanks be to God, who gives us the victory
Through our Lord Jesus Christ

[Verse]
If Christ had not been raised, our hope would be an empty word
We would still be in our sins, the saddest people on the earth
But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead
The firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep

[Chorus]
Death has been swallowed up in victory
Where, O death, is your victory?
Where, O death, is your sting?
Thanks be to God, who gives us the victory
Through our Lord Jesus Christ

[Bridge]
In an instant, in the blink of an eye, at the last trumpet
The trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable
And we will be changed
And we will be changed

[Chorus]
Death has been swallowed up in victory
Where, O death, is your victory?
Where, O death, is your sting?
Thanks be to God, who gives us the victory
Through our Lord Jesus Christ

[Outro]
He is not here; he has risen
Thanks be to God
